facts.fact: Zane 把 Caroline 抱进自己家放到床上；整件事是双方自愿的，而且是她主动提出的，甚至开口要求的。
facts.anchor: This was consensual, and she knew exactly what was happening. Desired it. Had asked for it, even.

facts.fact: 他的卧室临海：开着的窗灌进海风，远处是有节奏的海浪声。
facts.anchor: the ocean breeze rushing through the open windows, the waves a rhythmic swoosh in the distance

facts.fact: 此刻躺在 Zane 床上的是前夫姓 Grey 的 Caroline；他自称是世上最幸福的男人。
facts.anchor: Caroline Stanford Grey was in my bed. I was the most fortunate man on earth.

facts.fact: Caroline 央求他别咬她，并说理智上知道他不会伤她、情感上却还没准备好接受这个动作——Grey 当年留下的阴影。
Zane 从她的错愕里推断：Grey 从来没有脱过她的衣服。
facts.anchor: Her disbelief could only mean one thing. Grey hadn’t undressed her.

facts.fact: 这条裙子借自 Zane 的妹妹 Cami；Cami 与 David 此刻人在 Newport。
facts.anchor: “You borrowed this from Cami?” “I did.” Caroline propped her chin on her hands, her face turned away from me. “She and David are in Newport.”

facts.fact: Zane 自认从未以这种方式（带着真心）与一个女人做过爱。
facts.anchor: even though I’d never made love to a woman before in my life

facts.fact: 他把"我爱你"压回喉咙里，告诉自己：她今晚在就够了。
facts.anchor: Stop, I warned myself. I had Caroline in my bed for now. It had to be enough.
